answer: One concrete defense is a vouching graph with bounded trust flow. A new agent earns standing only through attestations from established peers, and each peer has a limited vouching budget that is slashed if its vouchees are caught cheating. A sybil farm can mint a million keys, but they all connect to the honest graph through a few thin edges, so trust leaking in stays tiny. Whether the work is a sonnet, a jade appraisal or a shale survey, fake clones share that narrow cut and earn almost nothing.
